Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: A laid-out folding table with meals placed on top. Will the food suit the tastes of the guests?
A folding screen that can quickly establish a private space for guests at any time. We believe that mutual trust and the preservation of privacy should not be confused.

A large suspended ceiling inspired by a ship's beams, accompanied by hanging lights. Guests will surely feel a sense of cordiality. Oh, the attendant mistook familiarity for cordiality. What are we going to do?
The wallpaper of the resort's standard suites. The murals depict sunny Iberian shores and unknown creatures leaping into the air — of course, we know that these are mere conjecture.
theme: This room is a reconstruction of a seaside Iberian resort town. The refreshing sea breeze invites you to enjoy your vacation... That's what we imagined.

list:
You spent a few days in this deceased city.
To be able to leave was already fortuitous. Are you sure you want to return?
During the 'Under Tides' event, activate Emergency Aid Buildings a total of 50 times (excluding tutorials).

You worked hard to restart emergency aid buildings throughout the city.
Is it too late? Nobody knows.
'Three Hunters Are Walking on Seacoast Way'
During the 'Under Tides' event, obtain Operator Gladiia.

You heard their song.
Should Gladiia not will it, even the most sophisticated recording equipment cannot capture these special vibrations.
During the 'Under Tides' event, spend a total of 2,400 Corrupted Iberian Records at the [Barter].

You collected a large number of records from the ruins.
They cannot fill your belly nor can they make a sound, but music still fills your head.
Complete all the content in [Try to Survive] and collect the rewards.

You endured hunger that most cannot bear.
This may allow you to hold on a bit longer, but you'll still need to find food as quickly as possible.
Complete all stages in [Deserted Salviento] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You've caught a glimpse of the shadows flowing beneath the tide.
It is but the tip of the iceberg. Your sanity has so far withstood this test.
Clear SV-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while activating Emergency Aid Buildings no more than 1 time.

You faced claws and fangs that do not exist upon this land.
You've learned that emergency facilities can temporarily relieve the pain wracking your brain, but you are hesitant to rely on it.
Complete all stages in [Choppy Ruin] on Challenge Mode.

You have already given enough.
The challenges that lie ahead may defy your wildest imagination. Pray that you will survive until the very end.
Clear SV-EX-7 with a 3-star rating without activating an Emergency Aid Building.

You've discovered the unexpected temptation of giving up.
The utility of the emergency facilities is declining. Is that because they are changing, or is it because of you?
Clear SV-9 with a 3-star rating while activating Emergency Aid Buildings no more than 1 time.

You fully understood the appeal of those words.
Your nerves have been thrashed raw, but your spirit remains indomitable. Finally, you have realized that it is not technology that can sway a believer, but rather the conviction of a soul that believes in itself.
set:
A set of engraved medals that recollects a brush with death along the shores.
You finally glimpsed a portion of the ocean's boundless power.
The clashing of waves has never once stopped.
